governedSurface.adoption: Founder tap required (stack tap gate, fail-closed without a verifier). Adoptions AND refusals are appended to the hash-chained stack audit log. runCycle never adopts.
governedSurface.csamDiscipline: Candidate content is screened at propose; a hit aborts that candidate, logged WITHOUT content, no override.
governedSurface.editSurface: Whole-content replacement of exactly ONE of the eight components per edit; unknown component names are dropped at propose.
governedSurface.probeCost: Surfaced in the audit trail per cycle (candidates probed); budgeting belongs to the governed router's lanes — the paper's own caveat is that multi-candidate probing multiplies test-time token cost, and its editor seat was a frontier model.
